title: Lower probability level
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $0<\epsilon<1/2$, and let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The biased-minus probability polynomial of $f$ at the lower parameter corresponding to level $\epsilon$ equals $\epsilon$; that parameter is the unique one in $(0,1)$ where the polynomial has value $\epsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
